France

FRANCE

Technical Support Instrument - Country Factsheet

The Technical Support Instrument (TSI) is the EU programme that provides tailor-made technical expertise to EU Member States to design and to implement reforms at the national level, with an emphasis on the green and digital transitions. The TSI also supported the preparation and implementation of Recovery and Resilience Plans.  

Initiated in 2021, the TSI is the successor of the Structural Reform Support Programme (SRSP). Since 2017, both programmes have helped design, develop and implement over 2000 reform projects in 27 Member States. 

COMPLETED AND ONGOING REFORM PROJECTS IN FRANCE*

72 Reform projects
France has has so far benefitted from 72 reform projects financed by the Technical Support Instrument or by its predecessor, the Structural Reform Support Programme.
11 Policy areas
The support addressed a broad range of policy areas, including public administration, better regulation, public spending, financial literacy, healthcare and education. A particular focus has been on digitalisation in both private and public sectors.
31 Multi-country
31 of the projects were part of a multinational effort to support reforms benefitting several Member States.

* The above data include all projects completed and ongoing at the time of the announcement of the annual TSI financing decision. During their execution, projects can be further split or aggregated, cancelled or withdrawn. Therefore, figures related to the approved reform support projects can slightly differ.

Reform projects approved under the Technical Support Instrument

The Technical Support Instrument yearly cycle is launched during the dedicated TSI Annual Conference. In May 2025, High-Level representatives from the European Commission and EU countries, showcased how EU support helps Member States deliver on their reform agendas and align national reforms with EU priorities. 

The conference also started the discussion with Member States on potential TSI 2026 multi-country projects - geared at addressing common issues among Member States thereby emphasizing the EU added-value of the instrument. 

2026

For 2026, the Commission approved the following 10 reform support projects for France:

  • PACE - European Victim Architecture Digital Evaluation (EVADE)
  • Integrating Artificial Intelligence in Public Financial Education: Towards an EDUCFI+ Model for France

Multi-country projects:

  • Economic Analysis for Climate Action 2
  • PACE - Spatial planning agencies joining forces for innovative practices and EU legislation effectiveness
  • Improving capacity in Member States to effectively implement the FASTER Directive
  • PACE - Strengthening EU Financial Intelligence Units’ capacities to combat money laundering and terrorist financing involving crypto-assets and decentralised finance”
  • PACE - European innovations to combat prison overcrowding (PACE INNOVAPRIS)
  • Support in joining the PPDS to build an EU level analytics scoreboard for below and above threshold procurement data
  • Energy Regulation Academy
2025

For 2025, the Commission approved the following 19 reform support projects for France:

  • Automation of routine tasks in judicial proceedings (ARTJP)
  • Accompagner les choix de vie des personnes en situation de handicap en transformant l'offre à travers trois leviers : l'évolution des pratiques professionnelles, la mobilité et la digitalisation

Multi-country projects:

  • Improving capacity in Member States to effectively implement the Pillar 2 Directive (Directive 2022/2523)
  • Facilitating the CSRD implementation by mapping the data sources
  • Inclusion of gender considerations in French public procurement
  • Supporting Digital Transformation in Competition Law Enforcement
  • PACE - Collaborative digital tools of European public services (France)
  • Strengthening Detection and Reporting of Bid Rigging in Czechia, France, Ireland, Latvia, Poland, and Portugal
  • Evidence-informed policy making for green and digital transitions
  • Mapping, common denominator, best practices and common dictionary of AML/CFT related STR reporting obligations, including financial data and transaction records, received spontaneously and upon request by private sector obliged entities
  • Enhance the skillset of the AMF staff on digital finance throughout the chain from policy to enforcement
  • Digital approaches to fiscal reporting
  • Gender mainstreaming in public policy and budget processes in Paris
  • National Strategy for the Development of Social and Solidarity Economy
  • Improving France Travail's services to citizens and businesses through the use of Artificial Intelligence
  • PACE - Transformation of European public services (France)
  • PACE - National file for non-EU citizens in short stays
  • EU Supervisory Digital Finance Academy: Strengthening Supervisory Capacity in Innovative Digital Finance
  • Implementing Effective Green Budgeting Practices
2024

For 2024, the Commission approved the following 10 reform support projects for France:

  • A better understanding of some populations, including vulnerable groups, to improve their digital financial literacy
  • Consolider et mettre en œuvre la feuille de route transition écologique de la Délégation Générale à l'Emploi et à la Formation professionnelle
  • Generative AI for the new AMF Missions
  • Intégrer les nouveaux systèmes d’information douaniers européens dans le dispositif de frontière intelligente entre la France et le Royaume-Uni
  • La transformation de la fonction ressources humaines au service des transitions managériale, écologique et numérique des administrations publiques
  • Piloter la question de la santé mentale dans une démarche école promotrice de santé jusque dans les établissements scolaires et en mobilisant l'ensemble de la communauté éducative
  • Support to the preparation of France's national restoration plan
  • Évaluation scientifique de la charge de travail des magistrats de l’ordre judiciaire français

Multi-country projects:

  • Artificial intelligence to tackle the non-take-up of social security benefits
  • Sustainability in Local Public Finances (SLPF)
2023

For 2023, the Commission approved the following 14 reform support projects for France:

  • Professionalisation of public procurement personal - fostering strategic methodologies, integrity and transparency
  • Supporting the successful implementation of the Regulation UE 2021/2282 on health technology assessment by HAS
  • Support to the CGDD phase 2
  • Technical Support Project on “Development of FIU’s expertise focused on digital finance and virtual assets”
  • Pour une meilleure mobilisation des programmes en gestion directe et indirecte dans les régions ultrapériphériques (RUP)
  • Vers une valorisation des compétences des seniors au sein du MESFIN

Multi-country projects:

  • PACE - Modernisation of the human resources management model
  • EU Supervisory Digital Finance Academy
  • ESG risk management framework for the financial sector
  • Proof of concept of AI models in market abuse monitoring
  • Improving the energy performance of State buildings in France and the Netherlands
  • Cartographie et correspondance des compétences numériques avec les compétences métiers dans la Fonction Publique Map & Match : le numérique au service des métiers des agents publics
  • Developing in-house capacity for Latvia and other Member States
2022

In 2022, the Commission approved 11 reform projects for France*:

  • « FranceJustice » - Création d’une application de téléconsultations en matière d’accès au droit et d’aide aux victimes d’infractions - Évaluation de la faisabilité et étude comparative
  • Enhance the French App for special needs education ("livret numérique de parcours inclusif")
  • Monitor the new regional schools for in-service training of educational staff in France ("Écoles Académiques de la formation continue")
  • Improving financial literacy of new retail investors for a better support in their investment decision-making process
  • Assessment, recognition and validation of skills and qualifications for refugees from Ukraine
  • General Technical Support for the implementation of France's Recovery and Resilience Plan

Multi-country projects:

  • Gender mainstreaming in public policy and budget processes
  • Baromètre de la complexité franco-allemand pour la simplification des démarches administratives transfrontalières - Vereinfachung der grenzüberschreitenden Verwaltungsverfahren
  • Continuité des missions du volet européen du SGPR après 2022
  • AML risk analysis and supervision in the area of correspondent banking, France
  • Micro-data platform for productivity

More information can be found in the 2022 Country Factsheets.

*Not all projects are listed for contractual reasons.

2021

In 2021, the Commission approved the following 4 reform projects for France:

  • Renforcer l’attractivité de la fonction publique dans les territoires
  • Reform of the French National Solidarity Fund for Autonomy
  • Transition écologique des services publics et application au Ministère de la Culture
  • Comprehensive review and benchmark study of the public real Estate management

More information can be found in the 2021 Country Factsheets.

Structural Reform Support Programme (SRSP) projects (2017-2020)

The TSI expands on the experience of the SRSP programme in building capacity in Member States. You can find the full list of SRSP projects here.

Highlighted projects

2024 - A better understanding of some populations, including vulnerable groups, to improve their digital financial literacy

The Commission aims at assisting the French Central Bank (BdF), the French Financial Markets Authority (AMF), the French Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority (ACPR) and the Institut d'émission des départements d'outre-mer (IEDOM).

2023 - For a better mobilisation of EU programmes under direct and indirect management in the outermost regions

The commission helped France strengthen the mobilisation of EU programmes managed at national level.
